---
title: "linkrot: URLs that try to run shell commands"
filters:
  - linkrot
extensions:
  linkrot:
    timeout: 5
---

Pandoc percent-encodes spaces, braces and backticks in URLs, so these
payloads use only characters it keeps: `$`, `(`, `)`, `'` and `;`.

- [unquoted](https://linkrot-test.invalid/$(touch$IFS'pwned-dollar'))
- [naive quotes](https://linkrot-test.invalid/x';touch$IFS'pwned-quote)
